variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .36 Caliber
variants.info:
A conversion for 1858 model revolvers.
A smaller caliber meaning it will not deal as great of damage, but has faster firerate and velocity.

variants.name: Snake Shot
variants.info: Changes your shot load into a special purpose pellet-loaded 44 magnum round. Six almost buckshot sized pellets that are great for putting pesky soldier vermin.
